Evidence & scope

Actual complete pinned APEX-Agents1.1 creator-card and release-article reads establish the same named APEX-Agents family across original and1.1versions, with expert world/task/rubric construction and explicit task/judge/environment revisions. The original five exact qualified observations are bound to distinct actual author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts at their respective source versions. Do not transfer original judge calibration or480task/33world counts to1.1card240task/31world/955criterion disclosure. Preserve CC-BY4.0card metadata alongside explicit evaluation-only/no-training/no-crawling restrictions without resolving their legal interaction. No payload was fetched, crawled, executed or audited. Full_source means available primary construction/evaluation/version documentation, not operational professional-work validation or experiment reproduction.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

APEX-Agents · documents: The original paper evaluates criterion judgments against 747 human labels across 60 tasks and reports 98.5% judge agreement on that calibration.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.apex-agents.judge-calibration

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Calibration belongs to the original Gemini-judge setup; it does not establish universal judge accuracy or release-1.1 reliability. The paper acknowledges small score-difference and same-family judging concerns.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

APEX-Agents · documents: The original protocol distinguishes average single-attempt task success, any-of-eight success and all-eight consistency; release 1.1 introduces expert audits and judge changes intended to reduce scattergunning and ambiguity.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.apex-agents.metric-and-release-audits

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Dense criterion credit, Pass@k and Pass^k have different meanings. Release changes and held-out judge-calibration subsets must not be pooled as one result.
